title: sql action
description: Runs an SQL statement on a database. A statement that returns rows makes the body <ResultSet><ResultSize>n</ResultSize><Results><Result><column>value</column>...; any other leaves the body. The headers numberOfRecords and hasErrors are set. The connection options may use ${...}, such as ${header.DB_Host}; connections are kept for reuse and closed when idle.

query.title: Query
query.description: The statement, a simple template evaluated for each message, usually ${body}; a final ; is left out

connectionType.title: Database
connectionType.description: postgres, mysql8 (also mysql, mysql5, mariadb), sql_server or oracle

host.title: Host
host.description: Host name or address of the database server

port.title: Port
port.description: Port; empty means the default of the database (5432, 3306, 1433, 1521)

database.title: Database name
database.description: Database, or for oracle the service name, such as xe

password.title: Password
password.description: Password; env DIF_SQL_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion) when the option is not set

escapeChars.title: Escape characters
escapeChars.description: Accepted for compatibility and without effect: how the platform escapes the characters of the query is not known

useSSL.title: Use SSL
useSSL.description: Connect over TLS, checking the certificate of the server against the trust store

tlsVersion.title: TLS version
tlsVersion.description: With useSSL: the one version of TLS to use, TLSv1, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2 or TLSv1.3; empty means 1.2 or later

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust with useSSL; "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)

connectTimeout.title: Connect timeout
connectTimeout.description: Milliseconds the connection may take to set up
